title: The 5 Busiest Airports on Earth, Ranked (#5 Jumped Five Places)

scenes.text: The busiest airport on Earth handles more people than live in Germany.
Number five: Shanghai Pudong. 85 million passengers in 2025, up from tenth place.
scenes.label: Shanghai Pudong · 85M

scenes.text: Number four: Dallas Fort Worth. 85.7 million passengers, even though its traffic fell last year.
scenes.label: Dallas Fort Worth · 85.7M

scenes.text: Number three: Tokyo Haneda. 91.7 million people through one city airport.
scenes.label: Tokyo Haneda · 91.7M

scenes.text: Number two: Dubai. 95.2 million, and the busiest for international flights.
scenes.label: Dubai · 95.2M

scenes.text: Number one: Atlanta. 106 million passengers in one year. That's nearly 300,000 every single day.
scenes.label: Atlanta · 106.3M

description:
The world's five busiest airports by total passengers in 2025, from ACI World's final rankings: Shanghai Pudong (85.0 million, up from 10th), Dallas Fort Worth (85.7 million), Tokyo Haneda (91.7 million), Dubai (95.2 million) and Atlanta (106.3 million).
Airports worldwide handled about 9.8 billion passengers in 2025.
Which of these have you flown through?
first_comment: Which airport would you put at number one for the worst layover? And what should we rank next?
